Evolutionary modernization theory argues that a society’s values
should change from materialism to post-materialism with continuous
economic development and improved economic security (Inglehart,
1997, in press; Inglehart & Abramson, 1994). Speciﬁcally, values pro-
gress from priority on survival values that stress economic and physical
security to those that focus on self-expression, and from traditional
values that stress conformity and deference to authority to rational
values that reﬂect a tolerance of individualistic achievement and re-
spect for diversity (Inglehart, 1997; Inglehart & Baker, 2000). As
Schwartz’s conservation and self-enhancement values reﬂect anxiety-
avoidance and self-protection, while openness to change and self-
transcendence values foster anxiety-free and growth (Schwartz et al.,
2012), we believe that material deprivation and economic insecurity
should produce a generation that embraces conservation and self-en-
hancement, whereas socioeconomic development and democratization

Materials were selected through a Google Images search using
‘‘Adam and Eve” and ‘‘Eve and Adam” as key words (search done
in January 2006, using the Italian version of Google). All 120
images appearing on the ﬁrst 3 pages of the two searches were in-
cluded in the analyses. After exclusion of images that could not be
coded (such as abstract representations, animals, single individu-
als), the ﬁnal material consisted of 90 representations of Adam
and Eve of different nature, including paintings, frescos, photo-
graphs etc. We coded the relative position in which Adam and
Eve appeared in the composition, as seen from the observer’s
perspective.
